name: FabricCLI
description: Run commands in the Fabric CLI
author: Microsoft
instanceNameFormat: Run commands in the Fabric CLI

inputs.name: fabricConnection
inputs.label: Fabric service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: if fabric service connection is not provided, authentication mode will be detected from environment variables. For details see [Environment Variables](https://microsoft.github.io/fabric-cli/essentials/env_vars/?h=en).

inputs.name: scriptType
inputs.label: Script type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Type of script: PowerShell/PowerShell Core/Bat/Shell script. Select Shell/PowerShell Core script when running on Linux agent or Batch/PowerShell/PowerShell Core script when running on Windows agent. PowerShell Core script can run on cross-platform agents (Linux, macOS, or Windows).

inputs.name: scriptLocation
inputs.label: Script location
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to script: File path or Inline script

inputs.name: scriptPath
inputs.label: Script Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fully qualified path of the script(.ps1 or .bat or .cmd when using Windows based agent) or a path relative to the the default working directory

inputs.name: inlineScript
inputs.label: Inline Script
inputs.helpMarkDown:
You can write your scripts inline here. When using Windows agent, use PowerShell or batch scripting. You can also pass predefined and custom variables to this script using arguments 

 example for PowerShell: 
az --version 
az account show 

 example for batch:
call  az --version 
call az account show

inputs.name: scriptArguments
inputs.label: Script Arguments
inputs.helpMarkDown: Arguments passed to the script. please enter arguments with a space between them. example: var1 var2 var3

inputs.name: FabricCLIVersion
inputs.label: Fabric CLI Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fabric CLI version installation (latest (v1.2.0) or specific version)

inputs.name: FabricCLIEncryption
inputs.label: Fabric CLI Encryption FallBack Enabled Configuration.
inputs.helpMarkDown: The CLI cannot run on Linux unless the checkbox is selected. For configuration details, see [Enable/Disable Encryption Fallback](https://microsoft.github.io/fabric-cli/examples/config_examples/#enabledisable-encryption-fallback).
